retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochromatic red studio portrait featuring a full-body subject and a prominent, sharp-edged cast shadow against a textured backdrop.
excludeWhen: modern minimalist sans-serif layouts are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A full-length portrait of a woman in a red cocktail dress standing against a deep red wall, characterized by a dramatic, dark cast shadow that mimics her silhouette and large-scale serif typography overlapping the background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject color matches background hue for monochromatic effect
Sharp, dark shadow provides the primary tonal contrast
Large display text occupies the upper right quadrant
Subject is positioned off-center to the left
coreInvariants: Monochromatic red color scheme across subject and environment
High-contrast hard-edged shadow cast directly onto the back wall

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body subject positioned in the left third of the frame, scaled to nearly the full height of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large display typography in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the subject's face, down the line of the dress, across to the dark shadow, and up to the large text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space on the right side, filled by the cast shadow and typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout with value contrast provided by lighting and shadows rather than hue shifts.
paletteRestrictions: White or pale pastel for text only

characterSpecificRedesigns: Descender of 'y' features a tight, elegant loop
Crossbar of 't' is short and sharp
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast display serif paired with a functional, wide-tracked secondary serif.
graphicDevices: Hard-edged cast shadow as a compositional element

preserve: High contrast between thick and thin strokes

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the transitional serif structure and elegant terminals.
Provides the necessary weight and classic 1960s feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a full-body studio portrait of a woman in a 1960s red cocktail dress against a textured red wall. Use a single hard light source from the left to create a sharp, dark silhouette shadow on the wall to her right. The entire image should be monochromatic red.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large display serif text in the upper right quadrant in a pale lavender color with tight leading. Add small, all-caps metadata text in the lower right quadrant in white with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly monochromatic red?
Is there a sharp, distinct shadow cast on the wall?
Does the display text have high stroke contrast and ball terminals?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the shadow matches the subject's pose
Ensure the text is legible against the red background
Verify the 1960s styling of the hair and dress
Confirm the monochromatic red theme is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochromatic Color + Hard Shadow Portrait + High-Contrast Serif Typography
